name: Edelweiss
beschreibung:
Situated at over 2,020 metres above sea level, Hotel Edelweiss in Kuehtai guarantees reliable snow conditions from November through late spring. Guests enjoy the effortless luxury of stepping directly from the hotel onto pristine ski pistes.

Comfortable rooms, sumptuous dining, and a relaxing wellness area complete an unforgettable high-alpine experience in every season.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Edelweiss in Kuehtai provides ski-in/ski-out luxury at over 2,020 metres in Austria's highest winter sports resort.
